description: Update the workspace's approval settings for member submissions and owner review. Only the workspace owner can change owner review. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

requireOwnerReview.description: Hold posts created by the workspace owner for explicit owner approval.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_approval_settings
title: Update Approval Settings
